text: So sorry to bother you this late, I'm probably being a silly old woman. I've got my granddaughter Isla staying, she's 8. Temperature was 37.9 earlier so I gave her some Calpol. In between doses she's been fine really, playing with her dolls, drinking her squash and chattering away to me. But when I was getting her ready for bed I noticed her lips look a funny bluey colour, and her skin's gone sort of grey and mottled in patches, like marble. She's never looked like that before. I didn't want to ring her mum and frighten her if it's nothing. Sorry again.
